_note_1: Two-branch TuckerDLinear (trend + seasonal). Keys match the current TuckerDLinear.__init__ signature in tucker_dlinear.py exactly.
_note_2: Two pair axes — _trend_pairs and _seasonal_pairs — let trend and seasonal ranks vary independently (cross-product). Each entry is an arbitrary kwarg bundle merged into the combo; keys ending in '_max' are clamped to pred_len and the suffix stripped (so rank_P_*_max entries stay safe across pred_len=5/21/63 sweeps).
_note_3: Trend spatial ranks default to (W, H) in TuckerDLinear when omitted — so 'full spatial trend' just means not specifying rank_W_trend / rank_H_trend in the pair. The diagnostic showed full spatial rank for trend was important; partial-spatial-rank variants are not included.
_note_4: kernel_trend fixed at 41 and g_init_noise fixed at 1e-3 — both diagnostic-confirmed. lr_g_mult and wd_g_mult are kept as axes (winner used 0.25 / 10) since these per-group multipliers were never directly ablated.
_note_5: AdamW + grad_clip=1.0 applied automatically by the sweep driver for tucker.
_note_6: Grid size for pred_len=21: 2 lr × 2 wd × 2 lr_g_mult × 2 wd_g_mult × 4 trend_pairs × 4 seasonal_pairs = 256 combos. Trim axes if running locally on MPS.
